lines.trans: Everyone, this is my closest friend—my bestie, Ms. Go Ara!
Outsiders probably picture us as same-age rivals—calling us rivals makes zero sense at all!
Whenever Ara lands a new commercial, I rejoice as if it were mine—even when she snatches my endorsement, I think "good for her"!
Let us pause briefly while we reset the cameras.
CEO Byun has totally lost her touch—I have to appear in two-shots beside her, so why book a girl with such a tiny face?!
Especially when my face puffed up from eating salty broth for days!
Each of you recorded a video letter for the other on your phone—please send it to each other's phones right now.
Wait—do the two of you not have each other's phone numbers?
We are exchanging numbers right this second!
We will wrap filming right here.
